notes.notes:
p-by-Step Implementation Roadmap
Requirements Analysis: Define entity attributes, user authorization roles, and API contracts for Authentication.
Database Schema Setup: Create Mongoose models/collections, indexes, and initial data seeds.
Backend Controller & Routes: Build Express REST API endpoints with request body validation and error handling.
Frontend Integration: Connect UI forms and data tables to REST endpoints with reactive loading state handlers.
Testing & Audit Verification: Execute unit tests (`node test.js`), check network status codes, and verify audit logs.

Learned about the multi-Vendor E-commerce Platform, its purpose, major users (Admin, Vendor and Customers), and the overall project workflow. The project uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST APIs and JWT authentication

Learned about the problem and solution of a multi-vendor e-commerce platform. The platform allows multiple vendors to manage products and customers to browse, add products to cart and checkout. Understood the roles of customers, Vendors and admins, along with the basic workflow, database, REST APIs and authentication process
Learned the Functional and technical requirements of system

Understood the complete workflow of the platform from user registration and product browsing to cart, checkout and order processing. Also learned how vendors manage products and orders and how administrators manage the overall system.
